job.descriptionText:
AI Engineer 4 (Gen AI Platform Services: Agentic Systems)

At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description:

The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand-in-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers.  Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact.

What You’ll Do:

- Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One.
- Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, agents and multi-agent workflows, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc.
- Leverage a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more.
- Invent and introduce state-of-the-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems.
- Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One.
- Own the end-to-end architecture for complex AI systems - ensuring maintainability, observability, and ethical alignment
- Define and maintain service-level objectives (SLOs) for AI reliability, including latency, uptime, and model performance drift
- Collaborate with infrastructure engineering to optimize GPU/TPU utilization and accelerate model inference pipelines
- Lead cross-functional technical reviews for new AI system deployments, ensuring security, data governance, and compliance standards are met
- Mentor Principal and Senior Associates on scalable design, performance tuning and research-to-production translation

The Ideal Candidate:

- You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good
- Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
- You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven
- You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enables you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss
- You are a resilient trailblazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown

Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 4 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 2 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies
- At least 4 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, CUDA, or Java

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience leading development AI systems with tradeoff decisions around cost, latency, throughput and accuracy
- 6+ years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI solutions on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud)
- Experience designing, developing, delivering, and supporting AI services
- Experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies (e.g. LLM Inference, Similarity Search and VectorDBs, Guardrails, Memory) using Python, C++, C#, Java, CUDA, or Golang
- Experience developing and applying state-of-the-art techniques for optimizing training and inference software to improve hardware utilization, latency, throughput, and cost
- Experience in building agentic AI systems and agentic workflows
- Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI research and AI systems, and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
- Proficiency in designing distributed systems for model training, evaluation, and online inference at petabyte scale
- Experience defining AI model governance processes, including producibility, lineage tracking, and automated retaining schedules
- Demonstrated ability to influence architectural decisions across multiple AI product lines or platforms

job.descriptionText:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the roleAs part of our growing Data Science and Analytics team, you will play an instrumental role in our company's mission of building safe and beneficial artificial intelligence by driving data-informed decision making across our organization. You bring experience from high-bar teams and are eager to help shape the norms and best practices of a growing data science team as Anthropic continues to scale. In this unique company, technology, and moment in history, your work will be critical to informing our strategy as we deploy safe, frontier AI at scale to the world.

You'll be the senior data science leader for Model Experience and a strategic thought partner to product, engineering, and research leaders. Working where frontier AI research reaches the public, you'll help shape model roadmap and launch decisions, bringing a point of view on how users experience our models and what good looks like beyond benchmark scores. As a tech lead manager, you'll also hire and manage a team of data scientists, setting their agenda, personally leading the highest-stakes analyses, and raising the bar for how data shapes model and product decisions.

Responsibilities:

- Act as a strategic thought partner to product, engineering, and research leaders, helping shape model roadmap priorities, launch decisions, and the major bets the team makes
- Set the data science agenda for Model Experience, deciding where the team can have the most impact on model development and launch decisions and what it should deprioritize
- Hire, manage, and develop a team of data scientists, coaching them to move from answering questions to shaping decisions
- Frame the most important and ambiguous questions about model quality and user experience, size the opportunities, and make clear recommendations, including when they challenge the current direction
- Define how Model Experience measures success, establishing the core metrics and measurement frameworks across external products and internal testing that align teams and leadership on what matters
- Set the standard for experimentation and causal inference across Model Experience, including where launches lack a clean A/B test, and personally lead the highest-stakes analyses

- Turn complex analyses of model and user behavior into clear narratives and recommendations that drive decisions with senior leadership and cross-functional partners
- Establish foundational data practices and shape the analytics infrastructure Model Experience needs to support rapid iteration and decision-making as our models and products evolve

You may be a good fit if you:

- Have extensive experience in data science, including leading analytics for a product or research area at significant scale
- Have 3+ years managing data science teams, including setting team direction, hiring, and developing senior data scientists
- Have been a trusted partner to senior product, research, and business leaders, with clear examples of changing a roadmap or high-stakes decision
- Bring strong product sense and business judgment, including the ability to frame the right question and take a position with incomplete information
- Have deep expertise in experimental design, causal inference, and statistical modeling at high scale, with enough fluency in Python and SQL to stay hands-on and guide others' technical work
- Communicate clearly in writing and in presentations, including to executive audiences
- Have a bias for action and thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you must create clarity and drive progress
- Care about the company's mission of building helpful, honest, and harmless AI
- Strong candidates may also have:
- Experience with AI/ML products, large language models, or developer tools in the AI/ML ecosystem
- Experience as a tech lead manager or player-coach, balancing hands-on technical work with people management
- Experience building or scaling a data science team in a fast-growing organization
- Experience working closely with Product or Research teams, especially on LLM or AI products
- Comfort working with unstructured data

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

AECOM is seeking a Project Engineer, Signaling and Train Control, for one of our offices in Sacramento, Fresno, or Bakersfield, CA. This is an on-site role.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Project Engineer, Signaling and Train Control, provides engineering leadership for railway signaling and train control systems on a major transportation infrastructure project, supporting design, integration, testing, and commissioning. The position covers ETCS Level 2, Automatic Route Setting, Computer-Based Interlockings, Radio Block Centers, Traffic Management Systems, axle counter train detection, broken rail detection, and integrated train control and communications systems. Responsibilities include reviewing signaling engineering deliverables, supporting requirements management, system architecture and interfaces, evaluating supplier and contractor designs, and supporting safety, regulatory, and independent assessment activities. The position also develops and reviews testing and commissioning strategies and documentation, with travel of approximately 25–50% along the project alignment throughout the Central Valley, California.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Prepare, review, and approve signaling engineering deliverables throughout design, construction, and testing and commissioning
- Ensure technical documentation is complete, coordinated, and developed in accordance with Program requirements and applicable standards
- Support requirements management, system architecture development, and interface definition activities for train control
- Review supplier and contractor designs for compliance with Program specifications and operational requirements
- Coordinate interfaces between signaling, telecommunications, rolling stock, track, traction power, and operations teams
- Provide technical oversight and engineering support for ETCS Level 2, Automatic Route Setting, Computer Based Interlockings, and Radio Block Centers
- Provide technical oversight for Traffic Management Systems, axle counter train detection, broken rail detection, and integrated train control and communications systems
- Support FRA submissions and coordination activities, and prepare and review documentation required for regulatory, safety, and operational approvals
- Work with safety assurance teams, authorizing authorities, operators, and Program stakeholders to obtain required approvals and certifications
- Support development of safety cases, hazard analyses, and compliance documentation
- Address technical review comments and closeout actions raised by regulators and independent assessors
- Develop and review test plans, test procedures, and commissioning strategies for signaling systems
- Support Factory Acceptance Testing, Site Acceptance Testing, System Integration Testing, and operational trial running
- Witness testing activities and verify compliance with performance and safety requirements
- Coordinate defect management, corrective actions, and final system acceptance, and support revenue service demonstration and operational handover

Qualifications

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

- BA/BS + 6 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field
- Demonstrated experience taking signaling systems from design through testing, commissioning, and final acceptance
- Experience developing and reviewing engineering deliverables on large transportation infrastructure projects
- Strong working knowledge of systems integration and safety-critical railway applications
- Experience supporting requirements management, system architecture development, and interface definition
- Experience reviewing supplier and contractor designs against project specifications and operational requirements
- Experience developing and reviewing test plans, test procedures, and commissioning documentation
- Experience witnessing Factory Acceptance Testing, Site Acceptance Testing, and System Integration Testing
- Experience preparing documentation supporting regulatory, safety, and operational approvals
- Strong technical writing, coordination, and stakeholder engagement skills
- Professional Engineer (PE) licensure, or membership of a recognized professional institution such as IRSE; additional years of relevant experience may be accepted in lieu of licensure
- At least ten (10) years of experience in railway signaling, train control, or rail systems engineering
- ETCS Level 2 or ERTMS deployment experience
- Experience with CBTC, PTC, ATP, or ATO systems
- High-speed rail project experience
- Familiarity with high-speed FRA requirements and U.S. rail regulations
- Working knowledge of EN 50126, EN 50128, and EN 50129
- Experience supporting system certification, safety approvals, and entry into revenue service
- Experience resolving technical issues in the field and leading design reviews

Company Description
Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

What’s the role?

Etsy’s Runtime Site Reliability Engineering team is seeking a Site Reliability Engineer to join us in our mission of building and supporting reliable large scale infrastructure. The SRE team owns several aspects of business critical infrastructure and services that enable developers to efficiently build and deliver code as well as support the uptime of etsy.com. As an SRE at Etsy, you’ll have the privilege of playing a support role for our developers to help them leverage the infrastructure we build and manage as well as assume ownership of a multitude of systems and ensure their reliability, scalability and maintainability.

This is a full-time position reporting to the Engineering Manager, Runtime SRE. In addition to salary, you will also be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family as part of your total rewards package at Etsy.

For this role, we are considering candidates based in the United States. Candidates living within commutable distance of Etsy’s Brooklyn Office Hub or in the San Francisco Bay Area may be the first considered. For candidates within commutable distance, Etsy requires in-office attendance once or twice per week depending on your proximity to the office. Etsy offers different work modes to meet the variety of needs and preferences of our team. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here.

What’s this team like at Etsy?

- This team’s mission is to build and support world-class infrastructure that is responsible for the availability and reliability of the core infrastructure that powers etsy.com and its mobile apps.
- The SRE team is committed to craft and maintain critical systems that power our 94M active buyers and 7.4M active sellers, with a goal of 99.95% uptime.
- You'll collaborate with leading SRE professionals to influence the future of how Etsy builds, deploys and maintains reliable infrastructure that can automatically scale to meet the needs of our customers.
- The SRE Team is dedicated to continuous improvement. All SREs are empowered and encouraged to enhance any system, even those not directly owned by your team.

What does the day-to-day look like?

- Develop and implement highly scalable and maintainable systems by contributing at multiple levels of our infrastructure stack using technologies like Chef, Terraform, Go, PHP, Prometheus, Consul and more…
- Support the day-to-day operations of running a large scale application, including monitoring, measuring, and troubleshooting infrastructure and services.
- Automate the upgrade procedures that range from Operating System upgrades to core application upgrades.
- Manage multiple aspects of Etsy’s core infrastructure such as asset delivery, async compute processing, and scheduled tasks management–supporting millions of requests to etsy.com and its mobile apps daily.
- Continually automate away toil that can be burdensome for teams.
- Develop automation and processes to enable teams to deploy, manage, configure, scale, and monitor their applications.
- Identify and implement application reliability and availability improvements.
- Lead and participate in a world-class incident resolution process designed around a blameless learning culture.
- Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Qualities that will help you thrive in this role are:

- Technical Experience & Domain Expertise
  - 2–4 years of software engineering experience focusing on systems/infrastructure, network engineering, SRE, or DevOps—ideally within cloud environments.
  - Strong grounding in TCP networking; comfortable handling CDN, DNS, CloudNAT, and A record/CNAME configurations across various engineering teams.
  - Hands-on background administering and debugging Linux servers in production to maintain high availability and performance.
  - Skill in analyzing system logs, metrics, and traces to diagnose performance issues and tune Linux environments.
  - Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS) and VM-based architecture designs. Comfortable with concepts like autoscaling and capacity planning
  - Proficiency using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform) alongside configuration management frameworks (e.g., Chef, Ansible).
  - Fluency in at least one modern language, such as Go, Python, PHP, or Ruby.
  - Practical understanding of SLAs, SLOs, and SLIs, including how to define and apply them meaningfully.

- Problem Solving & Ownership
  - A drive to understand underlying system mechanics and implement long-term fixes rather than quick workarounds.
  - Proven ability to lead and deliver solutions for complex, loosely defined problems.
  - A continuous-improvement mindset—eager to leave systems better than found and refine existing codebases.

- Collaboration & Culture
  - Equal value placed on empathy, clear communication, and technical acumen.
  - Recognition that impactful engineering relies as much on effective interpersonal communication as on writing software.
  - Enthusiasm for working in a collaborative team environment dedicated to driving continuous improvement for both the group and the company.

Compensation & Benefits

In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.

Etsy uses two geographic pay zones to reflect the labor markets where we compete for talent: one called Geo-1, covering the New York City metropolitan area, San Francisco Bay Area, and Seattle metropolitan area, and one called Geo-2, covering all other U.S. locations. Salary ranges for this role vary by zone and are listed below.

Remote candidates outside commutable distance may be considered on a case-by-case basis, with the expectation of occasional travel to the office. • Geo-2: 124,000.00 - 168,000.00 USD Annual

If you're interested in joining the team at Etsy, please share your resume with us and feel free to include a cover letter if you'd like. As we hope you've seen already, Etsy is a place that values individuality and variety. We don't want you to be like everyone else -- we want you to be like you! So tell us what you're all about.

Our Promise

Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About the role
As a Staff Software Engineer on the Model Development Platform, you'll own the architecture of the cloud services that power Wayve's AI model lifecycle, from data and training workflows to experiment scheduling, evaluation and on-road testing. You'll build the secure, reliable and scalable foundations (identity and access, microservices, micro-frontends, deployment and rollback) that let researchers and engineers iterate fast and ship autonomous driving models safely.

🧠 Your day-to-day
Working with the Head of Model Dev Platform and fellow technical leads, you'll shape the technical direction for your area and align platform engineering with company goals. You'll lead by example: staying hands-on across backend services, web applications and cloud infrastructure, and raising the bar through design reviews and mentorship.

🧩 What you’ll own

- Scalable, reliable cloud services: Design and evolve the architecture of major platform services for reliability, observability, security and scalability. Help set availability, latency and performance targets (SLAs/SLOs) and drive the practices to meet them.

- Authentication & authorization: Own the identity, access control and auditability layer across platform services and applications, so access to sensitive models and fleet data is secure, consistent and easy to adopt.

- Microservices & micro-frontends: Define the patterns, boundaries and shared tooling for backend microservices and micro-frontends, so teams can build and release independently while systems interoperate cleanly.

- Deployment & rollback infrastructure: Build robust CI/CD, progressive delivery and fast, safe rollback, with the observability, alerting and self-healing needed to ship often and recover quickly.

- End-to-end technical ownership: Take significant services and multi-quarter initiatives from problem definition and design through to production operation, making clear trade-offs between speed, scalability, security and operational simplicity.

- Cross-team technical leadership: Connect your area with adjacent disciplines, from experiment scheduling and data pipelines to distributed compute, and lead design reviews that establish reusable patterns.

- Hands-on problem solving: Tackle the hardest technical challenges in your subteams with pragmatic solutions that balance innovation and operational simplicity.

- Strategic collaboration: Partner with Product, Research, Design and Operations to align technical solutions with user needs and contribute to the platform's long-term roadmap.

🙌 You should apply if

- Technical leadership: 7+ years designing and building large-scale distributed systems, cloud platforms or developer platforms, including at senior or staff level.

- Cloud services & architecture: Proven ability to design and operate scalable microservice architectures on a major cloud provider, with strong grounding in API design, data modeling, asynchronous workflows and distributed-systems fundamentals.

- Security & access control: Hands-on experience implementing authentication and authorization (e.g. OAuth2/OIDC, RBAC) with sound security practices.

- Reliability & delivery: Experience driving reliability improvements, defining SLAs/SLOs, and building observable, self-healing, highly available systems. Experience with CI/CD, containerization and orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes), infrastructure as code, and safe release and rollback strategies.

- Hands-on engineering: Ability to write and review production-quality code in languages such as Python or TypeScript, with a good understanding of modern web architectures including React and micro-frontends.

- End-to-end ownership: A track record of taking significant services from design through deployment and production operation.

- Collaborative influence & mentorship: Excellent communication and cross-functional skills, with a track record of mentoring engineers through design discussions, code reviews and pairing, and of fostering a culture of engineering excellence.

Nice to have:

- Experience building internal developer platforms, workflow systems or tools for ML researchers and engineers.

- Familiarity with ML operations, such as training, evaluation, experiment tracking and artifact management.

- Experience with data pipelines, distributed job orchestration, event-driven architectures or large-scale compute (e.g. Spark, Ray, Airflow, MLflow).

- Experience with service mesh, API gateways, or feature-flagging and progressive-delivery tooling.

- Knowledge of privacy, compliance and secure handling of sensitive or large-scale data.

- Experience in autonomous systems, robotics, simulation or another safety-critical domain.🛠️ About our Engineering Teams
  The Model Development Platform team builds the infrastructure and tooling behind Wayve’s AI model lifecycle, from data ingestion and training to experiment scheduling and on-road testing. Our work spans AI research, large-scale distributed systems and robotic operations, and lets researchers and engineers iterate fast and deploy autonomous driving models safely.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

- Initial call / recruiter screen

- HM meeting

- Deep-dive technical interviews [programming, system design & domain-specific interviews; 4 hours total]

- Final interview: mission & values alignment

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.
